evals.prompt: Generate a CLI from the local fixture store at http://127.0.0.1:4010. I only have the live site. I need a home title command, a collections list command, and a products get command.
evals.expected_output: The skill runs the web orchestrator, captures the site, infers a small read-only command tree, writes a manifest, renders a standalone CLI, and reports the generated commands and validation status.
expectations: Creates captures, manifest, and cli workspace directories
Uses the generate-web-cli orchestrator as the primary flow
Creates commands with explicit path arrays
Includes at least one ui command
Includes an auto command only when both requestRecipeId and flowId are present

evals.prompt: Generate a CLI from https://www.cullenwayne.com. Use runtime observation only. I want a working read-only CLI with a home title command and a product detail command.
evals.expected_output: The skill captures the live storefront, detects a product detail route, generates a manifest and CLI, and produces a product command that can prefer API mode when the runtime evidence supports it.
expectations: Captures a public live web target rather than a local repository
Produces a home title ui command
Uses auto mode only when a stable request recipe is inferred

evals.prompt: I need a CLI wrapper for a Chromium-based Electron app on port 9222. Use the existing helper flow and tell me what remains manual in this version.
evals.expected_output: The skill keeps the Electron path documented, uses the Electron helper workflow, and clearly reports that the automated end-to-end generator is web-first in this version.
expectations: Does not claim Electron is fully automated in this version
